items.evidence: README command `leverage play .../work --ticks 300 --seed 1 --settings ... --inputs 0:enter,1:down,41:shoot` printed one JSON object with all brief keys (tick 300, screen play, ...); --at 0 shows screen title, menu_index 0, texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit].
README frame command (run from my scratch folder) wrote frame.png; PNG header reads 800x480. Same for 6 other frames I took.
Title texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]; inputs 2:down,4:enter -> tick 5 screen settings; 0:enter -> tick 1 screen play, wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5.
Settings, volume 8: right x3 -> 9, 10, 10 (stuck at 10); left x12 -> 0 and stays 0 at tick 40.

Right on Language: settings texts became [Ajustes, Volumen: 6, Idioma: Espanol, Volver]; title then [Defiende la puerta, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir], play [Puntos: 0, Oleada 1 de 5, Puerta: 5], paused [Pausa, Continuar, Titulo], lost [Has perdido, Puntos: 10, Enter: titulo].
Run 1 with --settings s2 set volume 6, language es; run 2 with s2 started at tick 0 with es/6 and Spanish title; fresh folder s3 started en/8.
Up held from tick 1: guard_y 6 -> 7.0 at tick 11, 9.0 at 31, 12 at 61, stays 12 at 100; down: 9.0 at 130 (0.1/tick = 6 u/s), 0 at 250 and stays.
Holding shoot: bolts spaced 5.6 units apart (24 ticks x 14/60), x advances 0.2333/tick; a bolt at x 19.5 at tick 120 is absent later; never more than one per 24 ticks.
Seed 1, no input: walkers appear at x=20 on ticks 1, 91, 181, 271, 361 in lanes 2,4,8,6,6, x drops 0.025/tick (1.5 u/s); no sixth walker in wave 1.
Guard at y=2 shooting: lane-2 walker health 2 -> 1 at tick ~110 with that bolt removed, gone with score 10 at tick 130; lane-4/8/6 walkers ahead of lane-2 bolts keep health 2.
No input: walker at x=0 at tick 801, gone at 802 with gate_health 5->4; at tick 1162 gate 0, screen lost, texts [You lost, Score: 0, Enter: title]; also lost with Puntos: 10 in another run.
Win script: wave 1 last walker destroyed at tick 453; wave 2 and first walker at tick 633 (180 ticks later), texts 'Wave 2 of 5'; 7th wave-2 walker spawned at 1173 (633+6x90).
My scripted seed-1 run (scratch plan.py) killing every walker reached screen won by tick 4920 with score 450, gate 5, texts [You won, Score: 450, Enter: title]; enter at 4950 -> title at 4951.

Escape at 100: screen paused [Paused, Resume, Title], walkers/bolts/guard identical ticks 100-199; Enter on Resume at 200 continues from the same positions; Escape, Down, Enter on Title -> title screen.
Seed 7 twice: identical output (same md5); seeds 2 and 3 give different lane sets (e.g. seed 7 lanes 10,6,2,4 vs seed 2 lanes 4,8,4,2,8).
play_es.png/play.png: gate strip at left, blue guard, red walkers and white bolts at pixels matching state (x*40, (12-y)*40), HUD 'Score/Wave 1 of 5/Gate' (Spanish in es run).
title_en.png (Settings outlined), title_es.png (Salir outlined, Spanish), settings_en.png (Volume: 9 outlined), settings_es.png (Volver outlined, Spanish).
assets/strings/en.json and es.json hold all words with same keys; UI files and lib.rs hold no display text; README 'Adding a language' explains copying en.json to XX.json.
README 'How to play' covers controls; its headless and frame commands ran as written and produced the JSON and an 800x480 PNG.

defects: The guard's centre is clamped to 0..12, so at the edges half the guard is drawn outside the field (at y=12 it is half off-screen under the HUD).
After the lost screen, or after Title from pause, the report still lists the frozen walkers of the abandoned run (title screen state shows walkers).
Start is drawn in a filled blue style on the title even when not selected, which competes with the focus outline as the 'chosen' marker.
A faint leftover panel is visible behind the settings box in the settings frame.
Any non-held input (enter, escape) releases held shoot/up/down, so holding shoot across a pause needs re-giving it (documented in README).

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
